{{Quote|There's never been a security fence Ryn couldn't get inside, and those are our caravan ships. Ours.|Mezza to Han Solo|<ref name="BP" />}}
'''Mezza''' was a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the leader of one of two clans of Ryn [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. She was an aging [[Gender/Legends|female]] with [[Color/Legends|graying]], red-orange [[Hair/Legends|fur]].<ref name="BP" />
